processing_steps_notes.value: The hot-rolled plate (parent process proc_hr) was annealed at 700 °C for 1 h followed by water quenching. At 700 °C the γ phase almost totally decomposed to lamellar κ-carbide and α matrix by the eutectoid reaction γ → α + κ; no γ phase was detected by XRD. Hot rolling/annealing schedule shown in Fig. 1.

The 700 °C specimen microstructure: γ almost fully decomposed to α + lamellar κ by eutectoid reaction, no γ detected, with large α grains and continuous boundary κ (b0030, b0047, b0033, b0061, b0063; Figs. 6, 7, 14).

overall_structure.value: After annealing at 700 °C for 1 h the γ phase has almost totally decomposed to α phase and lamellar κ-carbide by the eutectoid reaction γ → α + κ; no γ phase is detected by XRD (Fig. 14). The microstructure is composed of large α grains, continuous κ-carbide along grain boundaries, and areas containing lamellar κ-carbide within the γ matrix.
